content:
# S3 Logs Bucket with ACK: Bucket + Permissions

## Bucket Definitions

`dev/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-dev
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-dev
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

`prod/logs-bucket.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-prod
spec:
  bucketName: myapp-logs-prod
  versioningConfiguration:
    status: Enabled
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    rules:
      - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

## Permission Grants

Create separate policy files for the logs bucket permissions:

`dev/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

`prod/logs-policy.yaml`
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-policy
spec:
  policyName: myapp-logs-policy
  policyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

### Attachment to Existing Service Principals

Edit the existing `iam.yaml` files to attach these policies:

`dev/iam.yaml` — add to the existing `User` resource's `spec`:
```yaml
# Existing User resource — add managedPolicyArns if not present:
spec:
  userName: myapp-user
  managedPolicyArns:
    # ... existing policies from assets bucket ...
    - arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/myapp-logs-policy  # Reference the new logs policy
```

`prod/iam.yaml` — add to the existing `Role` resource's `spec`:
```yaml
# Existing Role resource — add managedPolicyArns if not present:
spec:
  roleName: myapp-role
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    # ... existing trust policy ...
  managedPolicyArns:
    # ... existing policies from assets bucket ...
    - arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/myapp-logs-policy  # Reference the new logs policy
```

**Note:** Replace `ACCOUNT` with your AWS account ID. The `managedPolicyArns` will resolve to the ARN of the Policy resource created by ACK once it's applied.

---

**Result:** Each environment now has a separate, isolated logs bucket with versioning, AES-256 encryption, blocked public access, and least-privilege S3 permissions (`GetObject`, `PutObject` only on the logs bucket, not the assets bucket).
